title: Cancellation and Fee Refund Terms by Northgate+ Tier
content:
Each tier of **Northgate Rewards and Northgate+ Memberships** sets when a cancellation takes effect, whether an immediate cancellation is offered, and the refund terms that apply to its fees.

| Tier | Full-refund window after a settled annual fee (calendar days) | Prorated refund on immediate cancellation | Proration basis | Cancellation of a monthly-billed or free membership takes effect | Immediate cancellation allowed |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Northgate Rewards | 0 | no | none | immediately | yes |
| Northgate+ Assist | 0 | no | none | at the end of the billing period | no |
| Northgate+ Student | 0 | no | none | at the end of the billing period | no |
| Northgate+ Monthly | 0 | no | none | at the end of the billing period | no |
| Northgate+ Annual | 30 | yes | unused full months | at the end of the billing period | yes |
| Northgate+ Business | 30 | yes | unused full months | at the end of the billing period | yes |

**Terms common to every tier**

| Term | Setting |
|---|---|
| The full refund inside the window requires zero benefit uses since that fee charge | yes |
| Rounding of a prorated fee refund | down to the cent |
| Refund owed on a duplicate fee or on a fee charged after a confirmed cancellation | the full amount |

**Definitions**

- *Full-refund window*: the calendar days after a settled annual fee within which cancelling with no benefit use refunds the full fee; 0 means no full-refund window.
- *Prorated refund on immediate cancellation*: whether immediate cancellation outside the full-refund window refunds a prorated part of the fee.
- *Proration basis*: unused full months refunds the fee multiplied by the whole calendar months remaining before the renewal date, divided by the term in months; none means no proration.
- *Immediate cancellation allowed*: whether the member may choose immediate cancellation instead of cancellation at term end.

**Points of reference**

- Only Northgate+ Annual and Northgate+ Business carry a full-refund window (30 calendar days) and a prorated refund.
- On Northgate Rewards a cancellation takes effect immediately; on the monthly-billed paid tiers it takes effect at the end of the billing period and immediate cancellation is not offered.
